title: 7AA.1 DIMASSOC documented DXF osnap fields
scope: Retain documented main-object osnap subentity and GS-marker values
Retain near parameter, complete WCS point tuple, and last-point flag
Preserve exact field presence and reject duplicate or incomplete typed state
Keep XREF/intersection reference edges guarded until remapping is modeled
Prevent DXF-only osnap details from being silently encoded as DWG

sources.title: Autodesk DIMASSOC (DXF)
sources.finding: The primary DXF group table defines 73 as main-object SubentType, 91 as its GsMarker, 40 as the Near-Osnap geometry parameter, 10/20/30 as the WCS osnap point, 75 as hasLastPointRef, and separately identifies XREF/intersection reference groups 301/302/332 and intersection subentity/marker groups 74/92.

sources.title: Repository-pinned ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1
sources.finding: The locally available PDF scan did not expose a DIMASSOC body prescription beyond its custom-class listing; this slice changes no DWG parser or body bytes. The DXF-only new fields are explicitly refused by the DWG encoder pending a DWG layout witness.

implementation.summary: DRW_DimensionAssociationOsnapRef now records optional main-object subentity type, GS marker, Near parameter, WCS point, last-point flag, and parser component-presence bits. DXF parsing preserves these fields and detects duplicate/incomplete state; the writer validates numeric domains and emits the documented fields in order. Intersection osnap types 6/11 remain unsafe because the intersection edge is not represented. The DWG encoder rejects any newly represented DXF detail before emitting bytes.
implementation.limitations: XREF handle strings 301/302, intersection handle 332, and intersection fields 74/92 are not represented or relocated and remain loss-guarded. This does not implement live associative updates, complete DIMASSOC support, or DWG DIMASSOC layout semantics.
